items.title: File Widerspruch against Krankengeld denial
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 27.01.2026, assumed also the posting date. Statutory delivery fiction for a Bescheid sent by simple mail (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) is the third day after posting: day of posting not counted (§187 Abs.1 BGB analog) -> 28.01 (1), 29.01 (2), 30.01 (3) = Fri 30.01.2026, no weekend/holiday, so Bekanntgabe = 30.01.2026. (The letter itself states a 'vierten Tag' rule, i.e. 31.01.2026, a Saturday; under the equivalent case-law rule that a fictitious-delivery day falling on a weekend/holiday moves to the next business day, that would be Mon 02.02.2026.) One-month Widerspruchsfrist per §188 Abs.2 BGB ends on the day in the following month numerically corresponding to the day of Bekanntgabe. Using the statutory 30.01 Bekanntgabe: '30 February' does not exist, so per §188 Abs.3 BGB the period ends on the last day of February 2026 (28.02.2026, a Saturday); moved to the next business day under §193 BGB -> Mon 02.03.2026. Using the letter's own (legally incorrect) 4-day rule with Bekanntgabe effectively on Mon 02.02.2026, the one-month period ends on 02.03.2026 (Monday), a business day, no shift needed. Both readings converge on the same final date.

warnings: The letter states the fictitious-delivery rule as 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post', but the applicable statute (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) provides for the third day after posting — this discrepancy should be checked with the Krankenkasse, though in this case it does not change the resulting Widerspruch deadline (both readings land on 02.03.2026 after weekend adjustment).
No explicit posting date is given; the calculation assumes the letter was posted on its printed date (27.01.2026).
